summary: The economy specialist: every NPC purchase -24%, every sale +24%, 8000-weight pushcart, then Vending for player shops. Fights with a basic weapon + Mammonite burst only when profitable.

skill_order.why: -24% NPC prices at 10: Knife 50->38z, Red Potions cheaper
+24% NPC sell price at 10: Sticky Mucus 35->43z; the passive zeny printer
8000-weight cart; Vending prereq at 3; move-speed penalty

equipment_order.name: Battle Axe [3]
equipment_order.why: ATK 80, req job? (item req lv3) - biggest NPC ATK merchant weapon

do_not_waste: Item Appraisal (1 pt at most; only un-IDs vendor junk)
Vending before holding surplus stock (no customers early)
Open Buying Store (renewal-era skill; exists server-side (ALL_BUYING_STORE needs Vending 1) but useless solo)
Crazy Uproar (quest, STR+4/30s, 8 SP - fun, not required)
renewal_differences: Discount/Overcharge/Pushcart/Vending numbers are era-stable. Renewal-era additions on the wiki page (Open Buying Store, Cart Decoration, offline vending) exist in this 2018 PACKETVER build but were not part of the classic pre-re kit - treat them as optional extras, not core.
